questions.label: OFFER
questions.title: What you are promoting
questions.question: What are we promoting, and where should the video send people? Give the exact name, then paste the web address.
questions.why: The story, the song and the call to action are all built around this.
questions.example: "My 6-week Confident Speaker program, https://example.com/speaker. Use my logo and the testimonial PDF." It has the name, the link and the assets.

questions.label: OFFER LINK
questions.title: Where to send people
questions.question: Thanks. What web address should the video send people to?

questions.label: AUDIENCE
questions.title: Who it is for
questions.question: Who is this video for, and what should they do after watching it?
questions.why: One audience and one action beat ten of each.
questions.example: "Women 35-55 who want a second income. Register for my free masterclass." One audience, one action.

questions.label: CHARACTER
questions.title: Who stars in it
questions.question: Who stars in your video? Give a name, an age, and how they look and dress. You can send photos in your next message, or skip that.
questions.why: Your characters are the actors, and viewers spend the whole video with them.
questions.example: "Tasha, a warm 40-year-old braider with locs, in a denim apron."

questions.label: AI MODELS
questions.title: Who builds and who checks
questions.question: Which AI setup should work on your video?
questions.why: One AI does the writing and planning, and a different one checks the work.

options.text: Use the setup on this computer
options.detail: MiMo 2.6 Pro builds, GLM 5.3 checks.
Tell me which one builds and which one checks.

questions.label: LENGTH
questions.title: How long
questions.question: How long do you want your ad to be? The longer ads also come with short clips you can post on social media.
questions.why: Length decides the story size and the price.

options.detail: The standard ad length.
Room for a fuller story.
Plus a 60-second clip and a 90-second clip.
Plus a 60-second clip and a 90-second clip.
Plus a 60-second clip and a 90-second clip.

questions.label: MUSIC STYLE
questions.title: The sound
questions.question: Which sound fits your story?
questions.why: The song carries the feeling of the whole ad.

options.detail: slow, heartfelt singing; builds to a big emotional chorus.
rhythmic rap verses, then a smooth sung hook you remember.
starts slow and sad, then lifts into an upbeat, hopeful groove.

questions.label: VIDEO STYLE
questions.title: The look
questions.question: How should your video look? Tap a link to watch a sample.
questions.why: The look is what viewers see in every shot.

options.detail: polished animated movie look with lifelike faces.
a warm, hand-painted cartoon from start to finish.
black-and-white pencil sketch that turns into real footage.
painted cartoon that turns into real footage.
painted cartoon that turns into lifelike 3D.

questions.label: CHECKPOINTS
questions.title: What you want to see first
questions.question: How much do you want to see before video money is spent?
questions.why: Fixing a script or a song is cheap; fixing a finished video is not.

options.detail: the script, 3 song versions to pick from, and the storyboard.
the storyboard, and nothing else.
Work starts as soon as you lock in your order.
answer the script, song and storyboard questions one by one.

questions.label: BUDGET
questions.title: Your spending limit
questions.question: What is the most this video may spend? Work stops and asks you before going over.
questions.why: This keeps you in control of the cost.

options.detail: the estimated price for your video, including a 50% allowance for redoing shots
type a dollar amount, like $25

questions.label: VIDEO MODEL
questions.title: Picture quality
questions.question: Which video model should make your shots?
questions.why: The video model sets how good the shots look and what they cost.

options.detail: great quality, best value
premium detail and motion
quicker and cheaper
top-tier realism

questions.label: SHAPE
questions.title: Tall or wide
questions.question: How should your video be framed?
questions.why: The shape decides how every shot is framed.

options.detail: phones, Reels, Shorts, TikTok.
YouTube on a TV or a computer.

questions.label: PHOTOS
questions.title: Photos and logos
questions.question: Which photos or proof should we use - your logo, a product shot, a testimonial?
questions.why: A real photo makes the story feel true instead of invented.
questions.example: "My logo and one product photo. I will send them after this."

questions.label: PURPOSE
questions.title: What is this video for?
questions.question: What is this video for?
questions.why: What the video is for decides its shape, its length and where it goes.

options.detail: the full package: a full episode for your YouTube channel, plus 60-second and 90-second trailers that send people to the full episode, and 60-second and 90-second ad clips that sell your product or service on Facebook, YouTube and TikTok.
turn a real client's own words into a short drama.
turn one point from your course or webinar into a song people remember.
a paid ad or a free post, made to fit the app you pick.

questions.label: EPISODE LENGTH
questions.title: How long
questions.question: How long should the full episode be? Your 60-second and 90-second trailers and ad clips are included.
questions.why: The full episode lives on your YouTube channel; the trailers bring people to it.

options.detail: The standard ad length.
Room for a fuller story.
one full story with room for the turn and the offer.
a deeper story with more of the solution at work.
the long version, a full show episode.

questions.label: PERMISSION
questions.title: Your client's permission
questions.question: Do you have your client's permission to use their testimonial?

options.text: No - pause this order until I have it.

questions.label: WHERE
questions.title: Where it will run
questions.question: Where will this video run?
questions.why: Each app has its own length and shape rules, so the video is made to fit the one you pick.

options.text: A free post - Reels, Stories or YouTube Shorts.

questions.label: AGNES
questions.title: Your Agnes plan
questions.question: Do you have a paid Agnes subscription (Starter, Plus or Pro), and should it make this video's pictures and clips?
questions.why: If you pay for an Agnes AI plan, your pictures and video clips can be made with it at no extra cost.

options.detail: Agnes video is 720p, a little softer than the studio's standard models, and the song and the talking close-ups still use the studio's providers.

options.text: No - use the studio's standard models.

supplementary_explanation: Option 1 uses the plan you already pay Agnes for to make the pictures and clips. The song and the talking close-ups are still charged to your studio balance, and that cost is in your estimate.
Option 2 uses the studio's own models for everything. You pick the quality next and see the cost before anything is made.
